description: Estimate the TRX cost and availability for a buy order before submitting it (api-key internal account). Requires an internal API key: `tronsave_login` (api-key mode, or signature mode for a wallet with an internal account) or an `Authorization: ApiKey <key>` client header. Never pass API keys as tool arguments; the server forwards the key from the session/header to TronSave. Use when the user wants a quote or price check; feed the result into `tronsave_internal_order_create`. Read-only. FRESHNESS: `unitPrice`/`estimateTrx` are live and can change roughly every 3 seconds — re-estimate immediately before creating the order.

durationSec.description: Delegation duration in seconds. Default 259200 (3 days) when omitted.

options.description: Optional flags that affect matching behavior for the estimate.

allowPartialFill.description: Allow partial fill so the order can match partially. Default true when omitted.

receiver.description: TRON base58 address that will receive the resource.

requester.description: TRON base58 requester; defaults to the API key account when omitted.

resourceAmount.description: Amount of resource to purchase (resource units).

resourceType.description: Resource type. Default ENERGY when omitted.

unitPrice.description: Pricing: FAST | MEDIUM | SLOW strategy, or exact unit price in SUN per resource unit. Default MEDIUM when omitted.

name: tronsave_internal_order_estimate
title: Estimate TRX Cost Before Order
